modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Brown (illness) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Brown is under the weather and could miss a third consecutive contest. If the rookie guard is unable to suit up, Egor Demin, Keon Ellis and Nolan Traore (calf), who is listed as probable, would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Traore (calf) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Traore appears on track to suit up despite dealing with discomfort in his right calf. The guard's expected availability should help Brooklyn maintain its backcourt depth, though his fantasy appeal remains dependent on his playing time and opportunities in the rotation. His status should be confirmed ahead of Saturday's tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Smith (hand) exited Friday's 125-117 win over the Hawks in overtime and did not return, finishing with 15 points (6-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds, three assists and three steals across 32 minutes.
injury.detail: Smith secured his third double-double of the season while tying his season-high mark in steals. However, the big man came down on his left hand in overtime and exited to the locker room. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of Saturday's game at Minnesota.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (left shin contusion) is listed as probable for Saturday against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Johnson appears to be trending toward availability after recently missing one game due to the shin injury. The rookie has averaged 6.9 points and 4.8 rebounds in 16.7 minutes per game this season, limiting his appeal to deeper fantasy formats.

injury.shortComment: Christie is questionable for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to a sprained left ankle.
injury.detail: Christie is at risk of missing the front end of this back-to-back set with a lingering injury. His absence would result in an uptick in playing time for Zaccharie Risacher and Naji Marshall, which would bolster both players' streaming appeal.
